faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Understand the boundaries before reading the result.

items.title: Is Life Ledger a budgeting app?
items.description: No. It plans personal cash flow and life events over decades instead of recording every purchase.

items.title: Does AI calculate the result?
items.description: No. Every core number and system analysis comes from deterministic software. A future planning assistant may explain results, but it will not replace the calculation engine.

items.title: Is the result a prediction?
items.description: No. It is a scenario estimate based on your inputs and explicit assumptions, shown in today's purchasing power to make plans easier to understand and compare.

items.title: What can the full ledger include?
items.description: You can add asset details, career changes, family support, children, housing, parents, retirement and one-time life events.

items.title: Does the quick calculator upload my data?
items.description: No. The landing-page calculation runs in your browser, and the full plan handoff stays within the current browser session.
